groups.defect: fetch_error_details pairs error IDs with nodestore mapping values positionally, misattributing event data when results are reordered or missing.
groups.rationale: All four identify the same zip(error_ids, events.values()) defect. Their differing examples describe consequences of the same positional-pairing assumption, resolved by looking up results by node ID.

groups.defect: The feature-gated dashboard table branch passes hardcoded empty columns and data instead of query results, rendering blank widgets.
groups.rationale: Both report the identical placeholder props in the same TableWidgetVisualization branch and require wiring in the actual table results.

groups.defect: The age/timestamp mutual-exclusion validators use truthiness instead of field presence, treating zero values as absent.
groups.rationale: Both identify the same checks in validate_timestamp and validate_age and propose the same presence-based validation.
